acceptanceCriteria: Set explicit fixture-local author/committer identity only for canonicalCreateRepo; preserve immutable object construction and provenance-failure assertions.
Both tests pass with absent ambient identities, disabled global/system config and user.useConfigOnly on actual Linux amd64 and Darwin.
Retain original failure and unchanged-environment controls; no global CI identity workaround or skip.
body: Confirmed hosted Linux amd64 PR476 head d5fdbe733b5bfbc0ff3c5a2aa2d1cc195bb8e0d2, Go1.27.1/Git2.55.0: two TestCanonicalDiffWithCreateDestinations tests fail at canonical_create_test.go:69/102 with git commit-tree exit128 Author identity unknown. canonicalCreateRepo initializes Git but never supplies author/committer identities before commit-tree. Ordinary local Darwin test with four identity variables unset/global config disabled passes through host identity autodetection; disabling that fallback via Git user.useConfigOnly reproduces both failures on unchanged source (identity-no-autodetect.log exit1). Existing makeRepo configures local user.name/user.email, unlike the new fixture. Expected fixture-local identities independent of runner/OS user data; do not configure CI globally or skip tests. Evidence /private/tmp/cem10-codex-control/pr476-linux-readonly-diag and pr476-linux-failure-events.json. No source repair; two-cycle limit exhausted and shared admission pending.
